theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.markov_rossoJones_torusLink {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {q : R} (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq1 : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) {B : Type u_2} [Ring B] [Algebra R B] {N : ℕ} {s : ℕ → B} (hs : IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalForm.HeckeFamily N (q - q⁻¹) 1 s) (t : B →ₗ[R] R) (ht1 : t 1 = 1) (hcyc : ∀ (x y : B), t (x * y) = t (y * x)) (hmark : ∀ k < N, ∀ x ∈ Algebra.adjoin R (s '' Set.Iio k), t (x * s k) = IwahoriHecke.TensorMarkovModel.zD q * t x) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ N) (p : ℕ) :
(q ^ 2 + 1) ^ (n + 1) * t (IwahoriHecke.JonesNormalForm.cox s n ^ p) = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), (q ^ 2) ^ m * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), rhoTr q n p j - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, rho'Tr q n p j)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.rossoJones_torusLink {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {q : R} (hq : q ≠ 0) (n p : ℕ) :
(IwahoriHecke.TensorMarkovModel.W q (n + 1) * gam q n ^ p).trace = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), (q ^ 2) ^ m * (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), rhoTr q n p j - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, rho'Tr q n p j)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.T_gam_pow {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {q : R} (hq : q ≠ 0) (n p m : ℕ) :
T (gam q n ^ p) m = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), rhoTr q n p j - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, rho'Tr q n p j

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.T_rho'_pow {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (n p j : ℕ) :
T (rho' q n ^ p) j = rho'Tr q n p j

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.T_rho_pow {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (n p j : ℕ) :
T (rho q n ^ p) j = rhoTr q n p j

noncomputable def QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.rho'Tr {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (n p j : ℕ) :
R

noncomputable def QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.rhoTr {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (n p j : ℕ) :
R

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.card_fixSet (n p j : ℕ) :
(fixSet n p j).card = fixCount n p j

def QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.fixCount (n p j : ℕ) :
ℕ

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.card_ones_eq (d k : ℕ) :
{c : Fin d → Fin 2 | ones c = k}.card = d.choose k

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.ones_perExt {n d e : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (he : n + 1 = d * e) (c : Fin d → Fin 2) :
ones (perExt hd c) = e * ones c

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.restr_perExt {n d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hdn : d ≤ n + 1) (c : Fin d → Fin 2) :
restr hdn (perExt hd c) = c

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.eq_perExt_restr {n d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hdn : d ≤ n + 1) (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) (hb : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), b (i - d • 1) = b i) :
perExt hd (restr hdn b) = b

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.perExt_periodic {n d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (hdvd : d ∣ n + 1) (c : Fin d → Fin 2) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
perExt hd c (i - d • 1) = perExt hd c i

def QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.restr {n d : ℕ} (hdn : d ≤ n + 1) (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) :
Fin d → Fin 2

def QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.perExt {n d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (c : Fin d → Fin 2) :
Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.rot_fixed_iff_gcd {n p : ℕ} (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) :
rot^[p] b = b ↔ ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), b (i - (n + 1).gcd p • 1) = b i

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.shift_mul {n : ℕ} (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) (s : ℕ) (h : ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), b (i - s • 1) = b i) (t : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
b (i - (s * t) • 1) = b i

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.T_wRot_pow {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {n : ℕ} (α β : ℕ → R) (p j : ℕ) :
T (wRot α β ^ p) j = ↑(fixSet n p j).card * (α j ^ (p - p * j / (n + 1)) * β j ^ (p * j / (n + 1)))

noncomputable def QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.fixSet (n p j : ℕ) :
Finset (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.lastOnes_mul {n p : ℕ} (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) (hb : rot^[p] b = b) :
(n + 1) * lastOnes p b = p * ones b

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.rot_fixed_iff {n p : ℕ} (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) :
rot^[p] b = b ↔ ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), b (i - p • 1) = b i

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.nat_nsmul_one_val {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
↑i • 1 = i

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.nsmul_one_self (n : ℕ) :
(n + 1) • 1 = 0

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.sum_range_mul_of_periodic (f : ℕ → ℕ) (P : ℕ) (hf : ∀ (k : ℕ), f (k + P) = f k) (t : ℕ) :
∑ k ∈ Finset.range (P * t), f k = t * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range P, f k

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.periodic_shift (f : ℕ → ℕ) (P : ℕ) (hf : ∀ (k : ℕ), f (k + P) = f k) (t k : ℕ) :
f (P * t + k) = f k

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.prod_wRot_weights {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {n : ℕ} (α β : ℕ → R) (p : ℕ) (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) :
∏ k ∈ Finset.range p, (fun (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) => if b (Fin.last n) = 0 then α (ones b) else β (ones b)) (rot^[k] b) = α (ones b) ^ (p - lastOnes p b) * β (ones b) ^ lastOnes p b

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.rot_iterate_last {n : ℕ} (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) (k : ℕ) :
rot^[k] b (Fin.last n) = b (Fin.last n - k • 1)

def QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.lastOnes {n : ℕ} (p : ℕ) (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) :
ℕ

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.rho'_eq_wRot {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (n : ℕ) :
rho' q n = wRot (fun (j : ℕ) => q ^ (n - j) * q⁻¹ ^ 2) fun (j : ℕ) => q ^ (j - 1)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.rho_eq_wRot {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (n : ℕ) :
rho q n = wRot (fun (j : ℕ) => q ^ (n - j)) fun (j : ℕ) => q ^ (j - 1) * q⁻¹ ^ 2

noncomputable def QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.wRot {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {n : ℕ} (α β : ℕ → R) :
Matrix (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) (Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) R

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.ones_eq_init {n : ℕ} (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) :
ones b = ones (Fin.init b) + if b (Fin.last n) = 1 then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.prod_qz_eq {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {n : ℕ} (q : R) (c : Fin n → Fin 2) :
∏ i : Fin n, qz q (c i) = q ^ (n - ones c)

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.ones_add_zeros {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Fin 2) :
ones c + {i : Fin n | ¬c i = 1}.card = n

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.prod_qo_eq {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {n : ℕ} (q : R) (c : Fin n → Fin 2) :
∏ i : Fin n, qo q (c i) = q ^ ones c

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.ones_snoc {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n → Fin 2) (x : Fin 2) :
ones (Fin.snoc c x) = ones c + if x = 1 then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.ones_rot_iterate {n : ℕ} (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) (k : ℕ) :
ones (rot^[k] b) = ones b

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.ones_rot {n : ℕ} (b : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 2) :
ones (rot b) = ones b

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.ones_comp_equiv {n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin 2) (e : Fin n ≃ Fin n) :
(ones fun (i : Fin n) => u (e i)) = ones u

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.ones_eq_sum {n : ℕ} (u : Fin n → Fin 2) :
ones u = ∑ i : Fin n, if u i = 1 then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.Archimedean.RossoJonesGeneral.T_gam_eq_sum {R : Type u_1} [Field R] {q : R} (hq : q ≠ 0) (n p m : ℕ) :
T (gam q n ^ p) m = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), T (rho q n ^ p) j - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, T (rho' q n ^ p) j
